name: Catatonic Game
storyline: Katrina, a regular domestic cat, is mysteriously transported to New Marilyn City—a bizarre place filled with strange characters, twisted experiments, and secrets lurking in every corner. Now transformed into an anthropomorphic version of herself, Katrina must unravel the mysteries of this city, ruled by the enigmatic Mobb Paw and haunted by the sinister experiments of Dr. Schwein. Along the way, you'll encounter quirky, unforgettable allies and navigate eerie environments, solving puzzles and using your wits to outsmart cunning bosses. Will you help guide Katrina home, or will the city's darkness consume her?
summary: Catatonic Game is a hand-drawn, 1930s-inspired puzzle-platformer adventure set in the mysterious New Marilyn City. Developed by a passionate indie team of four cousins from Bahrain under the company Fred Da Dead Productions, the game explores a world of anthropomorphic animals, hidden secrets, and surreal environments. Players will follow Katrina, a lost cat, as she embarks on a pacifist quest to uncover her true identity and return to her reality, solving puzzles and interacting with eccentric characters along the way.
